visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a dark night scene featuring brilliant blue bioluminescent spots in the water, transitioning to a sunny daytime beach. A young girl in a pink swimsuit and sun hat walks across the sand holding green toys, with a modern white building featuring angular architecture in the background under a blue sky. (2) The scene shifts to a detailed close-up of a breakfast plate containing sesame buns, a boiled egg, and fresh salad. A door then opens to a tiled balcony offering a vast view of the turquoise ocean. The camera captures the exterior of the white B&B building from a low angle, showing its unique sail-shaped roof against the shoreline. (3) Transitioning to nighttime preparations, lanterns illuminate a wooden walkway leading to the sea. Hands are shown selecting professional headlamps from a table, followed by a shot of a plastic bin filled with black water shoes. A man in a grey tank top and shorts stands on the dark beach, ready to guide a night tour. (4) During the intertidal exploration, close-ups reveal small crabs moving on the wet sand, a mudskipper on a rock, and a group of five-armed starfish in shallow water. A Golden Retriever with a pink collar walks through the water. A hand points to a horseshoe crab submerged in the shallows under a flashlight beam. (5) The footage returns to the bioluminescence, showing tiny glowing blue particles held in human hands against a completely black background. The screen is filled with scattered blue light points before showing a crab and shell in the water. A young girl with a headlamp is seen crouched in the dark intertidal zone. (6) In the concluding sequence, the girl is shown sleeping soundly on a white bed. This is followed by her dancing and jumping on the beach during the day, wearing the same pink swimsuit. The final shot is a wide view of the white B&B building framed by green hedges and a clear sky.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote a family-friendly B&B in Penghu by highlighting its unique features, specifically the night intertidal tour where guests can see marine life and bioluminescence ('blue tears'). It uses a high-energy, positive narrative to appeal to parents looking for immersive nature experiences for their children.
